cim: Liquid AI Releases d1.2 and d1.2-ultra: Omnimodal Decision Models That Top the AA Decision Index
cim_eredeti: Liquid AI Releases d1.2 and d1.2-ultra: Omnimodal Decision Models That Top the AA Decision Index
szoveg_eredeti:
Liquid AI just released d1.2 and d1.2-ultra . A decision model does not write text. It returns calibrated probabilities over a fixed set of answers. The Liquid AI d1.2 decision model family now accepts text, images and audio. It also adds 5 new answer types. d1.2-ultra scores 75 on the Artificial Analysis Decision Index v2.1 , the top score among decision models on the index. You can check the deployment options and specs here through our GPULeaderboard.com chrome extension . TL;DR Size: Parameters not disclosed. Up to 65,536 input tokens per question , 128 questions per call. Runs on: Hosted Liquid API only. No weights yet; Liquid AI says it will open them “at some point”. Performance: d1.2-ultra 75 and d1.2 69 on the AA Decision Index v2.1. Best: 0.8-point calibration error for d1.2-ultra across 13 benchmarks (Liquid AI test). What is Liquid AI d1.2? d1.2 is a hosted decision model from Liquid AI that answers typed questions about text, images or audio in 1 call. It returns a probability per option and generates zero output tokens , so only input is billed. d1.2-ultra targets harder decisions. d1.2 is faster and costs less than half as much. The model IDs are d1.2 (default) and d1.2-ultra . Earlier d1 , d1.1 and d1-ultra are now deprecated and do not support audio or the new tasks. What are the 5 new tasks in d1.2? d1.2 adds 5 typed answers on the same endpoint and request format: Read a value ( text , number , date ): returns the value plus the characters it came from. It answers “not found” instead of guessing. Find every span ( spans ): returns each matching passage, such as names or emails, with its position. Locate objects ( box , boxes ): returns 1 rectangle, or 1 per instance with a count. Estimate a number ( number with range ): returns a best guess and a range, for example 12 within 10 to 14. Pick every option that applies ( choice with multiple ): returns each matching label with its own probability. How does audio input work? Audio can be the subject of a question, such as which language is spoken or whether a siren is audible. The question can also be spoken. The API takes 16-bit PCM WAV and counts 10 tokens per second of audio. On held-out ESC-50 and FLEURS (43 languages) recordings, both models answer 95% to 97% of questions correctly. How does d1.2 score on the Artificial Analysis Decision Index? The index combines 6 evaluations. AA-Paperclip carries 30% of the weight. EvalSafe-O*NET-AA, AA-Omniscience-Decision v1.1, HLE-MultiChoice v1.1 and AA-Symmetry v1.1 carry 15% each. When2Call carries 10%. Its Decision Score penalizes confident wrong answers. On the AA chart shared by Liquid AI, d1.2-ultra scores 75. Drex Max v1.1, SubQ Snap 1.2 and GLiDE v1.2 follow at 73. d1.2 scores 69. That is 2 points below the deprecated d1-ultra at 71. Liquid AI argues no model scores higher than d1.2 for less money. How well calibrated are the probabilities? A calibrated model that says 80% is right about 80% of the time, so teams can route low-confidence cases to humans. Across 13 benchmarks and 22,505 questions, Liquid AI reports these calibration errors: d1.2-ultra: 0.8 points d1.2: 1.2 Jev 1.14: 2.7 Perplexity Decider v1.3: 3.7 GPT-6 Luna (Decisions API): 7.2 Note: These figures come from Liquid AI’s own test. How accurate are the new tasks? Liquid AI used held-out splits of public datasets; no public benchmark exists yet.  Pricing and deployment 

 Pricing is $0.02 per 1M input tokens for d1.2 and $0.042 for d1.2-ultra . New organizations get $2 in free credit on Liquid Console .

 Images cost 1.5 tokens per 32×32 patch, so a 1024×1024 image is 1,536 tokens. Shared state and media are billed once; each extra question adds only its own tokens.

 Request limits per call: 

 128 questions and a 4.5 MB request body

 8 images, or exactly 1 for box and boxes 

 8 audio clips and 300 seconds of total audio

 The endpoint is https://api.liquid.ai/decisions/v1/systemone . 

 Key Takeaways

 d1.2-ultra scores 75 on the AA Decision Index v2.1, first among decision models.

 Both models now read text, images and audio with 0 output tokens.

 5 new answer types: values, spans, boxes, ranged estimates, multi-label choices.

 d1.2-ultra reports 0.8-point calibration error vs 3.7 for Perplexity Decider v1.3.

 Hosted only for now: no weights, parameter counts or latency figures.

 Check out the launch blog , the d1 API docs and the AA Decision Index . You can check the deployment options and specs here through our GPULeaderboard.com chrome extension .
